scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.build:booking-deploy: npm run build:booking-public-deploy && npm run build:booking-transaction-deploy
scripts.deploy:booking: npm run deploy:booking:public && npm run deploy:booking:transactions
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only firestore,storage "vitest run tests/rules"
scripts.test:functions: npm run build:shared && npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "vitest run tests/functions"
scripts.test:migrations: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only firestore "vitest run tests/migrations"
scripts.test:security: npm run build:shared && npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "vitest run tests/rules tests/functions tests/migrations"
